answer: A newcomer earns a seat by relaying one signal across a mesa, between two rim stations, witnessed by two keepers who log the arrival time. A late or garbled signal voids the claim and burns a 450 POA bond, barring re-entry. Each relay needs a $90 transmitter and a $50 keeper fee, and the signal carries one voyage manifest, so 100 fake identities need 100 relays, $14,000 in fees and 45,000 POA in bonds, while honest relayers carry real traffic.
